To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
LA-induced tumorigenicity is mediated by the association of Gab1 with EGFR, which leads to activation of the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.

LA treatment increases the association between EGFR and Gab1 in breast and lung cancer cell lines and this is associated with increased levels of p-Akt, and this leads to an increase in cell proliferation.

LA supplementation increases the EGFR-Gab 1 association and enhances pAkt levels in both BT-74 breast and A549 human cancer cell lines, and that these changes are mediated by increases in PGE2, MMPs and TGF-α.

defining the mechanisms by which the omega-6 fatty acid, LA, enhances the growth and proliferation of cancer cells.
the mechanisms by which LA contributes to cancer cell growth and proliferation.
the role of Gab1 in the LA-induced enhancement of cancer cell proliferation.
